description: This file defines a utility function to suppress Node.js deprecation warnings. It attempts to set 'process.noDeprecation' to true, handling cases where this property might be read-only (Node.js v23+), and falls back to setting the environment variable 'NODE_NO_WARNINGS' to achieve the same effect.

methods.name: export function suppressDeprecations(): void { suppressDeprecations
methods.description: Function to suppress Node.js deprecation warnings by setting 'process.noDeprecation' or 'NODE_NO_WARNINGS' environment variable.
